info.title: FOSSBilling Extensions API (v2)
info.description: Self-service extension submission, ownership, moderation, and public browsing. v1 (/extensions/v1) remains available for existing integrations.

schema.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page
parameters.name: cursor

422.description: Filter or pagination query failed validation

post.summary: Submit a new extension, or an edit to one you own

201.description: Submission created and pending moderator review

403.description: Caller does not own the target developer or extension

409.description: Ownership or target changed, a duplicate is pending, or the pending limit was reached

get.summary: List the caller's own submissions, in any status
List submissions in the moderation queue

200.description: Submissions matching the requested status (default: pending)
Submission approved and written through to the live extension/developer

409.description: Submission is not pending, or ownership has changed since it was submitted

422.description: id param or review_note body failed validation

put.summary: Create or update the caller's own developer profile

200.description: Developer profile created or updated and usable immediately

403.description: This id matches a real GitHub organization or username that isn't linked to the caller's account

409.description: Developer id already taken by someone else, or id was changed on an existing profile

422.description: Payload failed validation, or the GitHub account type is unsupported

429.description: GitHub verification is temporarily rate limited

delete.summary: Permanently delete the caller's own developer profile

409.description: Profile still has published extensions, or has a pending submission awaiting review

post.summary: Re-check the caller's linked GitHub identity against their own developer profile

200.description: Verification re-checked (result may be verified or not)

422.description: The GitHub account type is unsupported

429.description: check_url was used again too soon, or GitHub verification is rate limited

post.summary: Request ownership of an unowned developer profile

201.description: Claim created and pending moderator review

403.description: Caller's linked GitHub account doesn't match this developer's GitHub organization or username

409.description: Profile is already owned, caller already owns a different profile, or already has a pending claim on this one

422.description: The request failed validation, or the GitHub account type is unsupported

429.description: GitHub verification is temporarily rate limited

post.summary: Withdraw the caller's own pending profile claim

404.description: No pending claim with that id owned by the caller

get.summary: List the caller's own profile claims, in any status

200.description: Claim approved; profile ownership transferred to the claimant

404.description: No claim or developer with that id

409.description: Claim is no longer pending, profile is no longer unowned, or the claimant now owns a different profile

404.description: No pending claim with that id

422.description: id param or review_note body failed validation

post.summary: Create a single-use link to hand this profile to another account

200.description: Transfer token created; share it out-of-band with the recipient

403.description: Caller does not own this profile

post.summary: Revoke this profile's pending transfer link, if any

200.description: Any pending transfer for this profile is revoked

403.description: Caller does not own this profile

post.summary: Accept a developer profile transfer using its single-use token

200.description: Profile is now owned by the caller

404.description: Transfer link is invalid, already used, or expired

409.description: Caller already owns a different developer profile

get.summary: List every developer profile, approved or not
List developer profiles awaiting moderator review

post.summary: Mark a developer profile as reviewed/approved

409.description: Profile changed after the reviewed revision

get.summary: List the write history of a developer profile

200.description: Snapshots of the profile, newest first
